### Notes

- Please speak English, this is the language all maintainers can speak and write.
- Please ask questions problems on our Discussions Forum (https://github.com/brendan-sadlier/pokero/discussions).
- Make sure you are using the latest release and
  take a moment to check that your issue hasn't been [reported before](https://github.com/brendan-sadlier/pokero/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3Abug).
- Fill in the below template with the most information you can provide

3. See error
